answer_1.quote: Data-to-text generation, i.e., generating textual description from structured data, is an important task ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language sentences describing the input structured data.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report the performance with BLEU , METEOR  and ROUGE-L ) using e2e-metric .

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to assess the factual accuracy of the generated sentences... We use AMT to distribute each generated sentence to four high-quality workers ...
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to rate each sentence as 1) hallucinating non-existing facts, 2) missing given facts without hallucination, or 3) accurate description of given facts.
